body:
## Describe the bug

Serving a hybrid-GDN model (Qwen3.6-27B, `qwen3_5` arch) with `--dtype float16` crashes at the first prefill:

```
File ".../sglang/srt/layers/attention/linear/gdn_backend.py", line 438, in forward_extend
    conv_states[forward_metadata.conv_states_mask_indices] = (
RuntimeError: Index put requires the source and destination dtypes match, got BFloat16 for the destination and Half for the source.
```

Cause: the conv state dtype is not derived from the model dtype. In `srt/configs/mamba_utils.py`:

```python
conv_dtype = dtype_map.get(envs.SGLANG_MAMBA_CONV_DTYPE.get(), torch.bfloat16)
```

The default is bfloat16 regardless of `--dtype`, and `--mamba-ssm-dtype` governs only the temporal state, not conv. The assignment at `gdn_backend.py:438` (`conv_states[mask] = mixed_qkv_to_track`) then receives fp16 activations into a bf16 buffer and index_put refuses the mix.

The mismatch crashes in both directions: `--dtype bfloat16` with `SGLANG_MAMBA_CONV_DTYPE=float32` produces the same RuntimeError with the dtypes swapped. bfloat16 models only work because they happen to match the default.

Workaround that confirms the mechanism: `SGLANG_MAMBA_CONV_DTYPE=float16` together with `--dtype float16 --mamba-ssm-dtype float16` boots and serves.

## Reproduction

```bash
# crashes at warmup prefill
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ \
  --dtype float16 --mamba-ssm-dtype float16

# boots and serves
SGLANG_MAMBA_CONV_DTYPE=float16 \
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ \
  --dtype float16 --mamba-ssm-dtype float16
```

## Suggested fix

Default the conv state dtype to the model dtype (or to the `--mamba-ssm-dtype` value when given), keeping the env var as an explicit override. Alternatively cast at the assignment site, but that hides the config mismatch. Happy to send a PR for the default change if that direction sounds right.

## Environment

sglang 0.5.14, torch 2.11.0+cu130, flashinfer 0.6.12, driver 595.71.05, CUDA 13.3, RTX 5090 32 GB (sm_120), single GPU, model QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ.

comments.body: I am taking this. I will preserve SGLANG_MAMBA_CONV_DTYPE as the explicit cache-layout override and fix the unsafe GDN snapshot write itself: normalize the tracked activation to the allocated conv-cache dtype before indexed assignment. This covers CLI/runtime dtype differences without changing temporal-state semantics. I will add CPU-only regressions for cross-dtype and same-dtype writes, then validate a single-GPU hybrid-GDN smoke once the local Linux runtime choice is confirmed. PR incoming.

title: [Bug] Hybrid-GDN models: mamba conv_states dtype ignores --dtype; float16 serving crashes at first prefill with index_put dtype mismatch
